name: Summon Guardian Ally (General)
body:
You can summon magical beasts and steadfast guard creatures to serve you.

Prerequisite(s): Summon nature’s ally spell or ability, nonchaotic alignment.

Benefit(s): Add the following creatures to the list you can summon with summon nature’s ally. These creatures can only be summoned in a location or situation typical of its kind, tough summoned guardians are less picky than a normal creature of its type. Spell-like abilities with a duration other than instantaneous used by guardian allies are dispelled when summon nature’s ally ends.

Summon nature’s ally I: badger, goat, gourd leshy, great horned owl, primate (baboon), skunk, swan (trumpeter)
Summon nature’s ally II: almiraj, axe beak (diatryma), amoeba (giant), leaf ray (no seed), ningyo, ram, reefclaw
Summon nature’s ally III: blink dog, foo dog, fungus leshy, hippogriff, kappa, shikigami kami, shocker lizard
Summon nature’s ally IV: flytrap leshy, foo lion, gargoyle, griffon, hydra, seaweed leshy, tanuiki
Summon nature’s ally V: divine guardian hydra, kodama kami, lotus leshy, hypnalis, lunar naga, mudlord, shambling mound
Summon nature’s ally VI: cerynitis, dosojin kami, gorgon, grey render, gynosphinx, stymphalidies, water naga
Summon nature’s ally VII: couatl, guardian naga, kapre, spirit naga, treant, zuishin kami, water orm
Summon nature’s ally VIII: amarok, cat lord, lorelei, lukwata, royal naga, sea serpent, thunderbird
Summon nature’s ally IX: azruverda, charybdis, cherufe, ghorazagh, red reaver, wakandagi, zuijin kami
